Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 3529 -1966 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
EYELET PLIERS 

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution 
on 18 May 1966, after the draft finalized by the Hand Tools Sectional 
Committee had been approved by the Mechanical Engineering Division 
Council. 

0.2 This standard has been formulated with a view to ensure a mininium 
standard of quality of the eyelet pliers so that they will have longer useful 
life. Also, this standard specifies certain basic overall dimensions of func- 
tional importance only vdthout imposing any limitation on details of 
design. 

0.3 For the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from 
IND/GS/ 1090 ' Pliers, eyelet * issued by Directorate of Technical Develop- 
ment ( Ministry of Defence ), 

0.4 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of 
this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, 
expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with 
IS: 2-1960*. The number of significant places retained in the rounded 
off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard covers the requirements for eyelet pliers. 

2. NOMENCLATURE 

2.1 For the purpose of this standard, nomenclature as given in 
IS : 2615.1964t shall apply. 

3. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS 

3.1 The material, manufacture, workmanship and finish, tests, preserva- 
tion; and packing and sampling shall conform to IS : 2615-1964t. 

♦Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ) . 
fGeneral requirements for pliers, pincers and nippers. 



K:3529-1966 

4. SHAPE AND DIMENSIONS 

4.1 The shape and dimensions of eyelet pliers, dies and the spring shall 
be as shown in Fig. 1 , 2 and 3 respectively.

5. HARDNESS 

5.1 The pliers and spring shall have hardness of 450 to 650 HV ( see 
IS : 1501-1959* ) or its equivalent in other scales. 

5.2 The dies shall have hardness of 550 to 650 HV ( see IS : 1501-1959* ) or 
its equivalent in other scales. 

5.3 The hardness shall be tested as specified in IS : 2615-1964t. 

6. WORKS INSPECTION 

6.1 The manufacturer shall maintain a system of works inspection at all 
stages of manufacture and shall ensure that the pliers are free from all 
manufacturing defects and comply in all respects the requirements of this 
specification. 

7. TESTING AND INSPECTION FAdLITIES 

7.1 The manufacturer shall supply the required sample or samples, the 
labour and appliances for such testing ( see also IS : 228- 1959 J ) as may be 
carried out by the purchaser or his authorized representative in accordance 
with this specification at the premises of the manufacturer or any other 
place mutually agreed upon. 

7.2 The purchaser or his authorized representative shall normally have 
free access to the works of manufacturer at all reasonable times to inspect 
the manufacture of pliers at any stage. The manufacturer shall, however, 
have the option, subject to mutual agreement prior to the acceptance of an 
order, to impose a limitation on the forgoing. 

8. MARKING 

8.1 The pliers shall be clearly and legibly stamped with the manufacturer's 
name, initials and/or recognized trade-mark and year of manufacture, if 
required by the purchaser. 

8.1.1 The pliers may also be marked with the ISI Certification Mark. 

Note — The use of the* ISI Certification Mark is governed by the provisions of the 
Indian Standards Institution ( Certification Marks ) Act, and the Rules and Regulations 
made thereunder. Presence of this mark on products covered by an Indian Standard 
conveys the asstirance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements 
of that standard, under a well-defined system of inspection, testing and quality control 



♦Method for Vickers hardness test for steel. 

fOfencral reqmrements for pliers, pincers and nippers. 

{Metbodsof chemical analysis of pig iron, cast iron, and plain carbon and low-alloy

during production. This system, which is devised and supervised by ISI and operated 
by the producer^ has the further safeguard that the products as actually marketed arc 
continuously checked by ISI for conformity to the standard. Details of conditions, 
under which a licence for the use of the ISI Certification Mark may be granted to 
manufacturers or processors, may be obtained from the Indian Standards Institution. 

9. TESTS 

9.0 In addition to the tests specified in IS : 2615-1964*, the following test 
shall also be carried out. 

9.1 Handle Load Test — The pliers shall be tested for deflection and 
pcnnanctit set in accordance with 9.5 of IS : 2615-1964*. The moment to 
be employed shall be 13 kgf-m and combined deflection and combineH 
permanent set shall not exceed 12*19 mm and 0*76 mm respectively. 



•General requirements for pliers, pincers and nippers.
